messages:
Ana: Hey team — I'm starting the observability rollout for the new GPU cluster in eu-central-1 (nodepool: g5xlarge-prod). Need quick validation for logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, and alert templates before we handover to oncall. TL;DR: fluentd -> otel-collector -> tempo + prometheus + grafana. Any blockers?
Sam: Nice. Quick checklist I ran through locally: 1) TF apply for infra 2) helm upgrade for prometheus/grafana/tempo 3) node kube-proxy / CNI checks 4) cost tags + autoscaler policies. Share outputs if you want a peer check.
Ana: Pushing the manifests now. Applying terraform state: `terraform apply -var region=eu-central-1 -auto-approve`
Sam: After apply, run: `kubectl -n observability get pods -o wide` — want to see prometheus, grafana, otel-collector, tempo, fluentd all in Running state.
Ana: Ran it. Output:
```
NAME                                    READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
prometheus-server-0                     2/2     Running   0          6m   infra-euc-1-node-02
grafana-6c7f9c6ccf-5xv2l                1/1     Running   0          5m   infra-euc-1-node-01
otel-collector-7fcd8d9b8-ktl9p          1/1     Running   0          4m   infra-euc-1-node-03
tempo-0                                 1/1     Running   0          4m   infra-euc-1-node-02
fluentd-logs-9k2jm                      1/1     Running   0          4m   infra-euc-1-node-01
```
Sam: Good, that looks healthy. Next validate ingest path: send a test log + a synthetic metric and a trace. Use loadgen job: `kubectl run obs-test --image=busybox --restart=Never -- sleep 3600` then `kubectl exec obs-test -- sh -c \"logger -t obs-test \"hello observability\"\"`
InfraBot: [deploy-bot] Prometheus chart v14 deployed in observability namespace (release: obs-prom).
Ana: Synthetic metric posted to Prometheus via pushgateway, and I can see it in PromQL: `rate(obs_test_requests_total[1m]) > 0`. Grafana dashboard link: https://grafana.eu-central.redwood/ d/obs/cluster-overview
Sam: Tempo traces look fine, flamegraph loads. Two quick notes: 1) Node labels for GPU scheduling added? Need `gpu=true` label on GPU nodes and `node.kubernetes.io/instance-type=g5.48xlarge`. 2) Ensure fluentd has egress to our log-ingest endpoint (TLS) — network egress rule 153 needs to allow 443 to logs.redwood-internal.
Ana: Labels applied. Egress rule is in the security group created by TF: `sg-obs-euc1` allows outbound 443 to 10.24.8.0/24.
Linda: From oncall handover perspective: add two alert templates before we sign off: - prometheus alert: HighIngestLatency (>=300s for 5m) - tempo alert: TraceExportErrors (>5 errors in 10m). Can you create PR with the alert rules and test them in staging? Also include runbook link.
Sam: I drafted alerts in `infra/alerts/euc1-observability.yaml` and pushed a branch: https://git.redwood/infra/alerts/compare/euc1-obs-alerts. Alerts include severity, pager, and runbook. Example rule snippet:
```
- alert: HighIngestLatency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 300
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High ingest latency in eu-central-1 observability pipeline"
    runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/obs-runbooks
```
Mike: Couple of cost things to note before handover: tempo retention default is 7d — for GPU clusters with high trace volume we should evaluate 3d retention + long-term cold store via s3-archive. Also autoscaler config for nodepool has min=3/max=50; consider bump min=5 for steady traffic.
Ana: Thanks, noted. I'll open an ops ticket to discuss retention and update the autoscaler in TF.
InfraBot: [incidents] New ticket created: OBS-2337 - tempo retention / autoscaler followup (assignee: Mike).
Linda: OK — once alerts PR merges and retention ticket is created, I can accept handover. Please confirm dashboard access for oncall and add playbook pointer in alert annotations.
Ana: Alerts PR is open, runbook link in annotations, dashboards shared with oncall team (group: #oncall-observability). Ready for final review.
Linda: Reviewing now, will merge and mark handover accepted if everything looks good. :thumbsup:
